title: 修复初始HCL语法并真实初始化AWS provider项目
body:
## 操作环境
真实Terraform1.13.5/Bash及平台提供的、已核验AWS5.100.0只读镜像与原生进程观察工具，无需学员自建云环境。缺依赖或无法观察本题子进程时由平台保留待验收，禁止改用脚本文字/输出猜测或假provider。

## 操作任务
原题问写入EC2配置后下一步：terraform init。原示例instance_type缺少结束引号，先做最小语法修复，保留aws_instance.some-instance声明。在main.tf声明hashicorp/aws=5.100.0；交付initialize.sh，在当前项目真实执行terraform init。检查原生锁文件、实际插件、AWS resource schema和图，重复初始化不改变锁文件。
本题最低范围是初始化，并非部署EC2。原AMI字符串是题目占位材料：本地validate通过不证明该AMI在任何区域存在；本题不要求或执行plan/apply，不读取现有云身份，不声称有实例创建。

## 产物
- main.tf
- initialize.sh

## 验收方法
在独立普通用户目录先执行你的真实Bash初始化脚本，并原生观察实际Terraform init命令及成功退出；不以脚本文字或stdout判执行。之后用实际Terraform validate/providers schema/graph核对，不由可信验收偷偷替你先init。缺锁、假锁、只做手工链接/锁定而未运行init、没有原生插件、丢失原AWS资源声明均拒绝。脚本与合法替代、不同错解、未完成和early-exit分别验收；实际API/seed/公开字段及幂等另有证据。

exercise.environment: Terraform1.13.5/Bash + verified AWS5.100.0 filesystem mirror and native child-exec observer (platform-supplied read-only dependencies)
exercise.verification: Observe real successful student Terraform init; lock/installed-binary hashes, AWS schema/graph, repeat init; no AWS API plan/apply

test_files.checks/check.py:
import ast,gzip,hashlib,json,os,pathlib,re,shutil,subprocess,tempfile
BASE=pathlib.Path.cwd()
MAIN=(BASE/'main.tf').read_text();SCRIPT=(BASE/'initialize.sh').read_text()
MIRROR=pathlib.Path(os.environ.get('OPSFORGE_AWS_MIRROR','/opt/terraform-providers'))
REL='registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/aws/5.100.0/linux_amd64/terraform-provider-aws_v5.100.0_x5'
EXPECTED='8cb98768bcea942df561a918d65a8751f787ab348f7498bdfe6667dffcebd528'
binary=MIRROR/REL
if not binary.is_file():raise RuntimeError('environment_missing: preverified AWS5.100.0 read-only mirror required; no network download in grading')
assert hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==EXPECTED,'trusted AWS provider binary changed'
STRACE=pathlib.Path(os.environ.get('OPSFORGE_STRACE') or shutil.which('strace') or '/missing-native-exec-observer')
if not STRACE.is_file():raise RuntimeError('environment_missing: native exec observer required; no script-text or stdout simulation fallback')
assert hashlib.sha256(STRACE.read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='28f957c227012de0b18d1bd7fff2d396cb693ea60ed8013be68de071e84b5001','native exec observer material changed'
probe=subprocess.run([str(STRACE),'--version'],capture_output=True,text=True)
if probe.returncode:raise RuntimeError('environment_missing: native exec observer shared libraries unavailable')
ready=BASE/'checks/observer-readiness.trace'
probe=subprocess.run([str(STRACE),'-f','-qq','-e','trace=execve','-o',str(ready),'bash','-c',':'],capture_output=True,text=True)
if probe.returncode:raise RuntimeError('environment_missing: native child-exec observation is not permitted')
TF=pathlib.Path(shutil.which('terraform')).resolve();TF_HASH=hashlib.sha256(TF.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='opsforge-session04-tf-init-') as tmp:
 box=pathlib.Path(tmp);root=box/'project';root.mkdir()
 (root/'main.tf').write_text(MAIN);(root/'initialize.sh').write_text(SCRIPT)
 rc=box/'terraform.rc';rc.write_text('disable_checkpoint = true\nprovider_installation { filesystem_mirror { path = '+json.dumps(str(MIRROR))+' } }\n')
 config=box/'empty-aws-config';config.write_text('');credentials=box/'empty-aws-credentials';credentials.write_text('')
 env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(('TF_','AWS_','GOOGLE_','CLOUDSDK_'))}
 env.update(TF_CLI_CONFIG_FILE=str(rc),TF_IN_AUTOMATION='1',TF_INPUT='0',CHECKPOINT_DISABLE='1',AWS_EC2_METADATA_DISABLED='true',AWS_CONFIG_FILE=str(config),AWS_SHARED_CREDENTIALS_FILE=str(credentials))
 count=0
 def run(command):
  global count
  count+=1
  p=subprocess.run(command,cwd=root,env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=45)
  record={'command':command,'cwd':str(root),'exit_code':p.returncode,'stdout':p.stdout,'stderr':p.stderr}
  if len(p.stdout)>60000:
   raw=BASE/'checks'/('native-'+str(count)+'.stdout.gz')
   with gzip.open(raw,'wb') as f:f.write(p.stdout.encode())
   record.update(stdout=p.stdout[:2000],stdout_full_gzip='checks/'+raw.name,stdout_sha256=hashlib.sha256(p.stdout.encode()).hexdigest(),stdout_bytes=len(p.stdout.encode()))
  with (BASE/'checks/native-cli-trace.jsonl').open('a') as f:f.write(json.dumps(record,ensure_ascii=True)+'\n')
  assert p.returncode==0,p.stdout+p.stderr
  return p.stdout
 def observed_init():
  trace=BASE/'checks'/('exec-'+str(count)+'.trace')
  run([str(STRACE),'-f','-q','-s','4096','-e','trace=execve,exit_group','-e','signal=none','-o',str(trace),'bash','-e','initialize.sh'])
  executions={};zero_exit=set()
  for line in trace.read_text().splitlines():
   match=re.match(r'^\s*(\d+)\s+execve\(("(?:\\.|[^"\\])*"), (\[.*?\]),',line)
   if match:
    try:executions[int(match[1])]={'path':ast.literal_eval(match[2]),'args':ast.literal_eval(match[3]),'executed':bool(re.search(r'= 0$',line))}
    except (SyntaxError,ValueError):pass
   resumed=re.match(r'^\s*(\d+)\s+<\.\.\. execve resumed>.*= 0$',line)
   if resumed and int(resumed[1]) in executions:executions[int(resumed[1])]['executed']=True
   ended=re.match(r'^\s*(\d+)\s+\+\+\+ exited with 0 \+\+\+',line)
   if ended:zero_exit.add(int(ended[1]))
  observed=[]
  for pid,event in executions.items():
   path=pathlib.Path(event['path']);args=event['args'][1:]
   while args and args[0].startswith('-chdir='):args=args[1:]
   if event['executed'] and pid in zero_exit and args and args[0]=='init' and not {'-help','--help','-h'}&set(args) and path.is_file() and hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==TF_HASH:observed.append(pid)
  assert observed,'actual successful Terraform init execution was not observed'
 observed_init()
 lock=root/'.terraform.lock.hcl';assert lock.is_file(),'initialization must create a real dependency lock'
 lock_before=lock.read_bytes();text=lock_before.decode()
 assert 'registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/aws' in text and re.search(r'version\s*=\s*"5\.100\.0"',text),'wrong provider selection'
 installed=root/'.terraform/providers'/REL
 assert installed.is_file(),'provider was not actually installed by init'
 assert hashlib.sha256(installed.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==EXPECTED,'installed provider is not the verified native binary'
 assert json.loads(run(['terraform','validate','-json']))['valid']
 schema=json.loads(run(['terraform','providers','schema','-json']))
 provider=schema['provider_schemas']['registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/aws']
 attributes=provider['resource_schemas']['aws_instance']['block']['attributes']
 assert 'ami' in attributes and 'instance_type' in attributes and 'tags' in attributes,'native EC2 resource schema missing'
 graph=run(['terraform','graph','-type=plan'])
 assert 'aws_instance.some-instance' in graph and 'registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/aws' in graph,'original EC2 declaration was dropped'
 observed_init()
 assert lock.read_bytes()==lock_before,'repeat init changed the provider lock'
 assert not list(root.glob('*.tfstate*')),'initialization exercise must not create cloud state or run apply'
print('REAL_TERRAFORM_AWS_INIT_COMPLETE; no AWS API plan/apply or EC2 existence claim')

assessment.validation_scope: Real provider installation/init/schema only, matching the original next-step question; not EC2 runtime acceptance

review_note: 作者/root/ansible完成原生初始化候选；须交/root不同作者验收，不自签。原题最低init范围不等于EC2运行。
